features.name: Personalized home content feed orchestration
steps: Normal videos / Shorts / ad slots are presented in a mixed structure
Each card type is correctly distinguished
features.expected: The home page must load the content stream and present normal videos / Shorts / ad slots in a mixed structure; each card type is correctly distinguishable (duration badge / layout differences); scrolling loads more content; blank cards or module crossings must not occur.

features.name: Dynamic filtering of recommended topics
steps: Tap topic chips such as "music / live / games / recently uploaded"
features.expected: After tapping a topic chip the feed must switch to the corresponding topic's content; each chip's result set is distinguishable; switching back to "all" restores the original feed; the filtering process must not lose loaded content or the scroll position.

features.name: Continuous content discovery and paginated loading
steps: The original feed position is restored after returning
features.expected: Scrolling down must keep loading new content without duplication or loss; after opening a video and returning the original feed position and loaded content must be restored; the loading must not trigger a full-page reload.

features.name: Global video search and result recall
steps: Returning to the search results preserves the query context
features.expected: The search results must match the keyword and include types such as videos/channels; after opening a result and returning the original query term and result-list state must be preserved; when the results are empty there should be a clear empty state.

features.name: Search suggestions and query-state management
features.expected: Suggestions must appear for partial keywords and change with the input; selecting a suggestion goes directly to the corresponding search results; historical queries can be reused; after clearing the history the state persists.

features.name: Establishing and dissolving the subscription relationship
steps: Its content appears in the subscription feed
It changes in sync after unsubscribing
features.expected: After subscribing, the channel button state must change immediately; the channel's content must appear in the subscription feed; after unsubscribing the corresponding content is removed in sync; the subscription relationship must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Subscription-feed aggregation
steps: Aggregate new content from subscribed channels
features.expected: The subscription page must aggregate new content from subscribed channels; switching the presentation by channel/time correctly reorganizes the set; tapping content opens the correct video; with no subscriptions an empty state is shown.

features.name: Subscribed-channel discovery and expansion
steps: The subscription page shows the preset channel set
features.expected: The subscription page must show the preset channel set grouped by theme; after subscribing directly the card state changes immediately; group switching gives correct results; duplicate channel cards must not appear.

features.name: Watch history is recorded automatically
features.expected: Videos meeting the watch condition must automatically enter the history; after playing again the record time/progress updates; the history is sorted by time; playback not meeting the condition must not be written into the records.

features.name: Watch progress and resume playback
steps: Play the video to a certain time point
Continue from close to the original progress
features.expected: After leaving and re-entering, playback must continue from close to the original progress; the progress must persist (kept after refreshing/reopening the browser); after playing from the beginning the progress resets correctly.

features.name: Watch-later workflow
steps: Add the video to "watch later" from the feed/video page
It appears in the watch-later list
features.expected: After adding, the video must appear in the "watch later" list; after playing or removing it from the list the original video page state updates in sync; the list content must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Playlist content organization and playback context
steps: Add different videos to a playlist
features.expected: After adding to a playlist the order is saved correctly; during sequential playback previous/next strictly follow the list order; the player must show the context of being in that list.

features.name: Like behavior and personal content aggregation
features.expected: After liking, the button state and count change immediately; the video appears in "liked videos"; after unliking both places are undone in sync; the state must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Video player lifecycle
features.expected: After opening the video the player must initialize and start playing; the play/pause/seek states respond correctly; after leaving the page the necessary state (progress) is preserved and resources are released correctly; playback can continue after returning.

features.name: Advanced player controls
steps: Volume, mute, progress, subtitles, settings, full screen, etc.
The player changes in real time after the adjustment
features.expected: Controls such as volume/mute/subtitles/full screen must act on the player in real time; the settings panel state matches the actual playback state; the adjustment must not cause playback interruption or progress jumps.

features.name: Continuous watching after playback ends
steps: Enter the next video according to the preset playback context (queue/playlist)
features.expected: After playback ends it must enter the next video according to the preset playback context; the switching must not lose the play-history record; the behavior at the queue/list boundary is well defined (stop or loop).

features.name: Video details linked with related content
steps: The related-video list on the right (preset)
The player and details switch as a whole
features.expected: The title/author/data/description must match the current video; the related-video list on the right is presented correctly; after tapping a new video the player and details switch as a whole without leftover information from the old video.

features.name: Shorts vertical continuous consumption stream
features.expected: Vertical swiping must switch to the next item and play automatically; the current video pauses/is destroyed and the next plays from the beginning; after switching several items in succession the playback state is always correct.

features.name: Shorts interaction state stays in sync continuously
steps: The state is preserved when returning again
features.expected: Like/comment/subscribe states are preserved after switching to the next item; when returning to the previous one the state matches the pre-operation state; the state must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Comment publishing and thread organization
steps: It still exists after a refresh
features.expected: The published comment must appear in the comment area immediately; replies form the correct hierarchy; after a refresh the comments and hierarchy still exist; the comment count updates in sync.

features.name: Comment interaction and sorting
steps: The Thread structure is not lost
features.expected: After liking a comment the count and state change immediately; after switching the sort mode the thread hierarchy is not lost; the sort results match the selected rule; the state is preserved after a refresh.

features.name: Comment replies and context location
steps: Establish the parent relation / mention markers
Tapping the context link locates the original comment
The hierarchy is preserved after a refresh
features.expected: A reply must establish the correct parent relation / mention markers; tapping the context link locates the original comment; the hierarchy and markers are preserved after a refresh.

features.name: Video links and recoverable positioning
steps: Copy the video link (optionally with a time point)
Locate the correct video and playback position
features.expected: A copied link must be able to reopen the corresponding video; a link with a time point must locate the correct playback position; clear feedback is given when link parsing fails.

features.name: Download-state management
features.expected: After triggering a download the state must change according to the flow; the "downloaded content" list shows the corresponding entry; after deletion it is removed from the list in sync; the state must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Content-creation entry orchestration
features.expected: Each creation entry must enter the corresponding workflow; different entries' workflows are distinguishable; the home-page state is preserved after returning; entries must not cross positions.

features.name: Video upload and publishing flow
features.expected: After selecting a local video the upload progress must be shown; the metadata and visibility configuration are saved correctly; after publishing the video appears in "my videos"; a clear state is given when the upload fails.

features.name: Display-preference configuration driving UI changes
steps: It is preserved after a refresh
features.expected: After changing the theme/language the site UI must change accordingly; the configuration must persist across refreshes; the switching must not lose the current browsing state.

features.name: Notification state and business-object navigation
steps: Deep Link to the target content
features.expected: The preset notifications must make the Bell show an unread state; opening a notification deep-links to the correct target content; after marking it read the unread count decreases in sync; the state is preserved after returning.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
Recommendation results and personalized feed ranking that change with user behavior
exclusions.reason: Requires a large-scale recommendation model and private behavior data (cf. Spotify "Recommendation / personalization engine"); the feed structure can be tested with preset fixtures

exclusions.feature:
Recommended channels / related-content recommendation algorithm
Recommended-channel cards and related-video recommendation ranking
exclusions.reason: The recommendation list can be presented with fixed fixtures; recommendation quality and personalization logic are not evaluated

exclusions.feature:
Live
Create a live stream, push the stream, real-time state transitions, and live viewing
exclusions.reason: Depends on real-time streaming infrastructure and streaming protocols (cf. Spotify "Live Events"); cannot be verified end to end without a streaming source

exclusions.feature:
Google account system and multi-account switching
Registration, login, identity switching, multi-account contexts
exclusions.reason: Accounts and identity services are external infrastructure (cf. Spotify "Account / Authentication complexity")

exclusions.feature: Real video transcoding / CDN distribution / content moderation
exclusions.reason: Depends on a proprietary media pipeline and moderation system; after localizing the upload flow only the user-visible state is verified

exclusions.feature:
Offline download and DRM playback
Real offline access, encrypted media, and device storage management
exclusions.reason: Download-state management (list/delete) is testable; real offline playback and DRM are not required (cf. Spotify "Offline download"); retained surface: f05 search suggestions and query-state management, f24 download-state management

exclusions.feature:
Third-party platform sharing integration
Sharing to external social platforms and cross-platform navigation
exclusions.reason: Link generation and deep-link positioning are testable; third-party platform integration is not verified; retained surface: f28 notification state and business-object navigation

exclusions.feature:
Advertising system
Ad delivery, targeting, bidding, and frequency capping
exclusions.reason: Ad infrastructure and targeting data (cf. Spotify "Advertisements"); the ad-slot structure can serve as feed-mixing fixtures

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of notifications
Real event generation for subscription updates/interactions
exclusions.reason: The notification state machine (unread/read/deep link) is testable and requires preset notification fixtures (cf. Spotify "Notifications"); retained surface: f28 notification state and business-object navigation

exclusions.feature:
Cross-user comment interaction
Notification delivery for others' replies/likes and @ mention delivery
exclusions.reason: Single-user comment publishing and hierarchy are testable; cross-user delivery and the messaging system are not verified; retained surface: f20 comment publishing and thread organization

exclusions.feature:
Real-time statistics
Views/likes changing in real time and live viewer counts
exclusions.reason: The statistics can use fixed snapshots; real-time sync and real counts are not required

exclusions.feature:
Location / restricted-mode content policy
Geolocated content, content rating, and moderation policy
exclusions.reason: Depends on external geographic data and content-rating systems; display preferences such as theme/language are kept; retained surface: f27 display-preference configuration driving UI changes

exclusions.feature:
Copyrighted content and real media assets
Real video content and licensed music assets
exclusions.reason: Real content is not a benchmark asset (cf. Spotify "Real copyrighted audio streaming"); use synthetic fixture media
